body:
It would be really good to just visualise our funding process... and then that might make it easier for people to understand how / where to start.

Can also plug into the upcoming [@OpenSquare](/edgeware/account/jNzH4yMQxUp7NF1xMDcgTmejNHo9z8VTKdK9Sg3KYNeRRxF) [treasury interface](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/2069-proposal-dashboard-for-edgeware-treasury) if it is approved.

This feels like a good destination for educating people on the process 

Three references: 
- [Proposal, Treasury, Governance Waterfall ](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/705-edgeware-governance-treasury-community-waterfall)
- [Who is the treasury for, what is the process ](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1150-what-is-the-treasury-for-who-should-benefit-and-how)
- [Edgeware grant funding structure ](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1110-edgeware-grant-programme-structure-discussion)


Shall we try and work from basics up and just push forward our initial treasury / gov standards?
